out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Observed restricted, commercial use pesticides present (can of raid insect spray) in the facility (next to back door) are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: CFM removed can of raid from facility and agreed to not use the product.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Box of clam-shelled plastic to-go boxes were found stored on the floor in front of the front hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. CDI: CFM relocated box of plastic to-go boxes to shelf in the dry storage area.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors in between kitchen equipment (oven and grill) is in need of cleaning in the main kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS instructed CFM to frequently clean floors in between kitchen equipment frequently to prevent debris build-up.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee personal cellphone stored in areas that may contaminate (food, food-contact surfaces of equipment) food prep counter in main kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: CFM relocated employee cellphone to designated storage area. CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized food prep counter before returning to food prep.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked pasta noodles and sliced tomatoes inside walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM placed date label on housemade TCS food items stored inside the walk in refrigerator.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Observed restricted, commercial use pesticides (raid insect spray) present in the back kitchen are are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: CFM removed raid spray from kitchen.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED THE CFM TO RE-WASH HIS HANDS PROPERLY AT A HAND SINK AS ALL SINKS HAVE A SPECIFIC PURPOSE.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: 1) CANNED TOMATO SAUCE PORTIONED INTO 2.5 GALLON CONTAINERS OBSERVED IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AT 44-46F FROM THE DAY BEFORE
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna).EHS INSTRUCTED THE CFM TO DISCARD THE SAUCE AS IT DID NOT COOL DOWN TO 41F WITHIN 4 HOURS.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF CONDIMENTS, OIL, 2) SHAKERS OF DRY SEASONINGS, 3) LARGE BULK BIN OF FLOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED THE CFM TO PROPERLY LABEL THE WORKING CONTAINERS AS DISCUSSED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food and beverages directly stored on the floor in the walk-in refrigerator (Corrected). Observed beverages directly stored on the floor at the front counter area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PURCHASE MORE NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ENSURE FOOD AND BEVERAGES ARE STORED OFF THE FLOOR BY 6 INCHES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO KEEP ALL WET TOWELS IN A SANITIZING SOLUTION. ONLY CLEAN TOWELS MAY BE SITTING ON WORK SURFACES. DIRTY TOWELS SHALL BE STORED IN A LAUNDRY BAG FOR CLEANING. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed clean equipment found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization on the shelves at the dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO ENSURE ALL CLEANED AND SANITIZED EQUIPMENT IS FULLY AIR DRIED BEFORE BEING STACKED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP AND TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED. Ledo Pizza (Inspection Date: 07/09/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean equipment observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward while in storage.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TURN ALL THE ITEMS UPSIDE DOWN WHILE IN STORAGE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed boxes of single service take home containers stored directly on the floor in the dish washing area of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS TO GET THE ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed clean take home/catering containers found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO KEEP ALL THE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS EITHER IN THEIR ORIGINAL PACKAGING AT ALL TIMES OR IF REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING, STORED UPSIDE DOWN ON SHELVES. ENSURE CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Soda crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): 1) ELEVATE PIZZA BOXES OFF THE FLOOR IN THE HALLWAY STORAGE CLOSET.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE THE SODA CRATES AND PROVIDE NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. Ledo Pizza (Inspection Date: 07/09/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) ALUMINUM FOIL LINING SHELVING UNITS AT THE 2DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR, 2) CARDBOARD LINING A DUNNAGE RACK WHERE OIL IS STORED IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE ALL ALUMINUM FOIL AND CARDBOARD BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) SHELVING UNIT LOCATED ABOVE THE 2DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR, 2) SMALL FAN HANGING ABOVE THE 2DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PERFORM MORE THOROUGH CLEANING AS NEEDED TO REMOVE FOOD DEBRIS, FOOD SPLATTER, AND FOOD RESIDUE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved splitter on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE THE SPLITTER AT THIS TIME AND ORDER THE PRESSURE BLEED VALVE TODAY AS DISCUSSED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed one kitchen hand sink basin slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CLEAR ANY POTENTIAL CLOG BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that some areas of the kitchen walls are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CLEAN THE KITCHEN WALLS AS NEEDED TO REMOVE FOOD SPLATTER BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:sausage @ pizza pre table=80F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. discarded during the inspection.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed boxes of food supplies stored on the floor inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s):Soda crates and milk crates being used as storage racks.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: The refrigerated pizza preparation table.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under the fryer is in need of cleaning. Grease crust was noted on the floor under this equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
